# Clinical features at T (generated by `python -m polysafe.features`)

All features use only data with offset <= T = 24 h; pre-ICU measured values look back at most 7 days (D3.7). Missing = not measured by T; it is never filled with a normal value here. APACHE scores are excluded (D3.1). Left out of the logistic regression only (D3.6): lactate, ph, phos.

Cohort: baseline A, all sites n = 868; primary sites n = 671.
